functions.name: np.mean
functions.desc: Arithmetic mean of an array. axis=0 averages down columns, axis=1 across rows; omit axis to average everything into one number.

examples.code:
import numpy as np
m = np.array([[1, 2], [3, 4]])
np.mean(m, axis=0)  # [2. 3.]  (column means)
np.mean(m, axis=1)  # [1.5 3.5](row means)
